description: Shows what a covered call position returns for a given stock move, call strike and option premium, compared with owning the stocks alone. Same math as https://www.vistashares.com/covered-call-calculator/.

premium_pct.description: Option premium received, in percent of the position. Accepts 0 to 50; default 2.

stock_return_pct.description: Stock return over the option period, in percent (for example 8 or -12). Accepts -100 to 200; default 8.

strike_pct.description: Call strike, in percent above the current price. Accepts 0 to 100; default 5.

name: covered_call_outcome
title: Covered call outcome calculator
